eval_instance_default: run a SWE-Bench style evaluation on a test instance using the modal backend
eval_instance_modal: evaluate a test spec against a predicted patch inside a Modal sandbox container
eval_instance_general_modal: run a general evaluation with custom test scripts and patches in a Modal sandbox
EvalResult: create a frozen dataclass representing an evaluation outcome with pass, fail, env_error, or timeout status
GIT_APPLY_CMDS: use the list of git apply and patch commands to retry applying a diff with multiple strategies
